result.summary: Version 1 of the TikZ figure compiled and passed topology validation. The Critic scored it 0.95 with no must-repair issues and all labels (A–G) present. It draws the parallelogram ABCD with apex E, the segments BE, AD, EG, DC, BG, BC and AB, the interior points F and G, and the unlabeled junction point_05 on AD and EG, with E–G drawn as one continuous stroke. No right-angle marks were added because none were detected.
